summary: Valley Electric Association (VEA), an electric cooperative in the CAISO area that says it is not a public utility under section 201(f), asks FERC to rescind the June 18, 2026 show cause order as to VEA. It also conditionally asks for more time to respond.
ask: Rescind the show cause order as to VEA. If FERC has not acted by November 16, 2026, extend VEA's response time until thirty days after FERC rules on the motion.

points.point: VEA asks FERC to rescind the show cause order as to VEA, citing the Commission's statement that it would do so at a non-public utility's request.
points.quote: asks the Commission to rescind its June 18, 2026 show cause order as to VEA, as the Commission has said it will do at a non-public utility’s request.

points.point: VEA says it is an electric cooperative and not a public utility under section 201(f) of the Federal Power Act.
points.quote: VEA is an electric cooperative that is not a public utility under Section 201(f) of the Federal Power Act

points.point: VEA says any large load in its territory would connect to the 230 kV system of GridLiance West, a public utility that remains a respondent.
points.quote: Any large load seeking service in VEA’s territory would, either directly or through VEA, interconnect to the 230 kV system of GridLiance West LLC (“GLW”), a public utility that remains a respondent in this proceeding, rather than to VEA’s 138 kV facilities.

points.point: If FERC has not acted by November 16, 2026, VEA conditionally asks for a brief extension of its time to respond until the Commission rules.
points.quote: If the Commission has not acted on this motion by November 16, 2026, VEA conditionally requests, pursuant to Rule 2008, a brief extension of its time to respond to the Show Cause Order until the Commission rules.

points.point: VEA reports that it conferred with CAISO, which supports the motion.
points.quote: VEA has conferred with the CAISO in advance of this filing and is authorized to state that the CAISO supports this motion.

points.point: VEA concludes a section 205 filing is not warranted for it.
points.quote: VEA has therefore concluded that a Section 205 filing is not warranted

throughLine.text: Asks FERC to remove VEA from the E-10 CAISO show cause proceeding rather than answer its directives. FERC's order said it would rescind at a non-public utility's request.

figures.label: VEA annual retail sales
figures.quote: sells approximately 577,130 MWh’s of electricity per year
